Create a vertical comparison from the uploaded photo: the original above, a colorful yarn-embroidery reinterpretation below. Give both halves the same dimensions; keep the upper image unchanged and avoid borders or labels.

Rebuild the lower scene as a tactile handmade patch on ivory woven cloth. Use chunky stitched contours, looped yarn, layered thread, and small relief shadows. Retain the people, poses, clothing colors, distinctive objects, and main action; simplify background clutter. Faces turned away must remain turned away. Every illustrated element should look sewn, not printed. Photograph the needlework straight on under gentle studio light.

Beneath the stitched scene, embroider three centered lines: [TITLE], [EDITION], and [CAPTION]. Use bold raised lettering for the title and smaller stitching below. Reproduce supplied text exactly. For omitted fields, invent a short English title and warm caption; use PATCH NO. 01 as the default edition. Never print placeholder brackets. Return only the completed comparison.

fragments.text: Transform the observed person into a cute silicone keychain figure, retaining recognizable facial and outfit cues.
Use softened source colors and restrained pastels rather than unrelated decorative patterns.
Simplify body proportions into a large rounded head and small coherent limbs while preserving the observed pose.

Omit name tags, lettering, brands, packaging and additional toy copies.

Original person count and recognizable pose despite explicitly permitted toy proportions.
Complete head, coherent limbs and secure attachment of the single added keyring.
negative: Unrequested people, duplicate subjects or malformed anatomy.

Clipping the main subject or erasing its identifying features.

fragments.text: Redraw the supplied object as an industrial blueprint visual concept based only on observed external parts.
Use crisp white and pale-blue linework on a deep blueprint-blue field.
Differentiate primary contours, visible joints and secondary detail with controlled line weights and dashed construction guides.
Keep surfaces schematic and unshaded; avoid photographic textures or decorative grunge.
Suggest volume through coherent perspective and visible construction, not glossy photographic lighting.
Keep one principal object legible; lightly separate only clearly observed components when needed.
Use unlettered leader lines sparingly; do not invent hidden mechanisms, dimensions or functional specifications.
Output a single clean blueprint artwork without labels, stamped codes, logos or claims of fabrication accuracy.

sourceProvenance.source_text: 双重曝光，Midjourney 风格，融合、混合、叠加的双重曝光图像，双重曝光风格。一幅由 Yukisakura 创作的杰出杰作，展现了一个奇妙的双重曝光构图，将阿拉贡·阿拉松之子的剪影与生机勃勃春季里中土世界视觉上引人注目、崎岖的地貌和谐地交织在一起。沐浴阳光的松树林、山峰和一匹孤独的马穿过小径的景象从他身形的纹理中向外回响，增添了叙事和孤独的层次感。当简洁分明的单色背景保持着锐利的对比度时，美妙的张力逐渐形成，将所有焦点吸引到层次丰富的双重曝光上。其特点是阿拉贡剪影内部充满活力的全彩色方案，以及用情感的精确性描摹每个轮廓的清晰、刻意的线条。(Detailed:1.45). summaryZh: 把照片主体的可见结构描成深底上的蓝色发光线图，用一处克制的红光强调关键部位，形成清晰而不虚构内部组织的观察图。
summaryEn: Describe visible source structure with clean luminous blue lines on a dark background, highlighting one observed feature in restrained red without inventing hidden anatomy.

samplePrompt: An ordinary realistic still-life photograph of one whole green fern frond in a narrow clear cylindrical vase. The frond has one central stem and paired leaflets with visible natural veins; all leaf tips remain inside the frame. Plain dark gray studio background, soft side light, complete transparent vase and waterline visible. No text, labels, logos, watermark, glowing outlines or diagrams. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280.
sampleAnalysis: Planned synthetic source: An ordinary realistic still-life photograph of one whole green fern frond in a narrow clear cylindrical vase. The frond has one central stem and paired leaflets with visible natural veins; all leaf tips remain inside the frame. Plain dark gray studio background, soft side light, complete transparent vase and waterline visible. No text, labels, logos, watermark, glowing outlines or diagrams. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280. Verify the actual generated source before publishing; the planned description does not override observed facts. Allowed result changes: Trace only visible branching, veins, seams or structure; darken the background and add one red accent without inventing hidden organs or machinery.
mediumAnchor: An observational luminous structural illustration with clean blue contour and branching lines and one restrained red focal highlight.

fragments.text: Translate the subject into a luminous structure study based only on connections actually visible in the photograph.
Use clean blue lines on deep navy and one small muted-red accent on a clearly observed important feature.
Trace major outer contours and internal visible branching with deliberate continuous strokes.
Keep most surfaces dark; show fine structural hierarchy without scanning noise or random particles.
Use narrow luminous cores and restrained halos with no theatrical lens flare.
Preserve observed geometry, branching direction, openings and attachment points of the source subject.
Do not invent hidden anatomy, organs, bones or mechanical internals; this is an illustrative visual concept.
Output one coherent structure artwork without labels, medical claims, text, logos or watermark.

preserve: Observed subject count, identifying silhouette and coherent part connections.
Actual source orientation, structural gaps and recognizable topology.
The complete main subject, except geometric changes explicitly permitted above.
negative: Unrequested people, duplicate subjects or malformed anatomy.
New logos, watermarks or unreadable pseudo-lettering.
Clipping the main subject or erasing its identifying features.
acceptanceZh: 线条对应可见结构，而非臆造内部组织。
分枝、接缝与连接关系保持。
只有一处克制红光重点，主次清楚。
无医疗诊断暗示、标签、粒子或文字。
acceptanceEn: Lines correspond to visible structure, not invented internal anatomy.
Branching, seams and attachments remain coherent.
A single restrained red emphasis creates a clear focal hierarchy.
No medical inference, labels, particles or text appears.
geometryNoteZh: 仅描绘源图可见的分枝、叶脉、接缝或结构；允许暗化背景和红光重点，不生成看不见的骨骼、器官或机械内部。
geometryNoteEn: Trace only visible branching, veins, seams or structure; darken the background and add one red accent without inventing hidden organs or machinery.

Edit the uploaded portrait into a polished, approachable LinkedIn profile photograph. Preserve the person's exact identity, facial structure, age, skin tone, hairstyle, and natural skin texture. Do not reshape the face, lighten skin, or change gender presentation.

Use a centered head-and-shoulders composition, upright relaxed posture, direct eye contact, and a subtle natural smile. Dress the person in neat, understated professional clothing suited to their existing presentation. Use a softly blurred neutral gray background and flattering, soft studio light with gentle facial shadows and natural catchlights. Retouch only temporary distractions; keep distinctive features intact.

Output a square photorealistic image with comfortable headroom and enough space around the face for a circular profile crop. No text, logos, heavy beauty filters, or artificial plastic skin.

Use consistent camera angle and crop, fully visible hair and narrow even gutters in every cell.

Return a single nine-cell image without labels, missing cells, extra identities, logos or watermark.
